observations.sourceCaption: Sample G S-2 foundation plan: five porch support locations, each with one C1/C2/C3 mark and one FD-1/FD-2 mark. Schedules are on the same sheet.
distractors: Round B/S-3 and C/S-3 section callouts
Hatched NOT IN SCOPE existing building
observations.unresolvedBoundary: Counts cover these five porch support locations only. Tags do not establish capacity, soil bearing, field condition, installed quantities or compliance. Column schedule defines types, not expected quantities.
observations.usefulExperiment: SAM discover/select five small post symbols, Muse read each nearby pair of marks, deterministic group by type and trace every mark to same-sheet schedules and S-3 detail E.

observations.objectType: Same five post/support centers in prepared crop
observations.sourceCaption: Prepared 300 DPI crop includes all five post centers but clips portions of left footing/tag context.
observations.unresolvedBoundary: Do not evaluate whole footing masks against this cropped input; use expanded porch crop for complete tag/context inspection.

observations.objectType: Open bolt-hole circles in detail E
observations.sourceCaption: Sample G S-3 E BASE PLATE DETAILS: four open circles in FULL PLATE and two in HALF PLATE AT WALLS. Printed callout says 5/8-inch diameter holes, typical.
observations.unresolvedBoundary: Six drawn circles across two alternative details. They are not six installed bolts, nor a total project anchor quantity. Section D shows two anchors in cut while its note calls for four: visible section marks must not be equated to total anchors.
observations.usefulExperiment: Compare noun prompt bolt hole with geometric small outlined circle; require one-to-one localization of four full-plate and two half-plate holes; keep non-hole circles/text as false positives.

observations.objectType: One concrete footer section and one aluminum post in detail D

observations.unresolvedBoundary: Useful for selecting the footer as evidence and linking its printed detail values to FD-1 schedule. A mask does not verify dimensions, concrete volume, reinforcement cover, capacity or total anchor quantity.
observations.usefulExperiment: SAM select footer and post separately using concept/box/positive-point prompts; Muse transcribe printed dimensions and note references from original source.
